_about: The suite's Free and Subscription page (plans.html; Scott chose B of notes/suite-plans-B-desk-2026-10-22.png, 2026-10-22). One card per app: what's free, and what a subscription adds. Herd Planner's and the Grazing Planner's rows are their own Two Ways cards' rows, word for word (tests/test_plans.py checks them against the apps' pages when the apps sit beside this project). Only what exists goes under a subscription; a planned feature goes under 'coming'. No prices until billing is built (decided 2026-10-22). The master list is the FirstLightAg project's claude/subscription-benefits.md.

free: Your herd's records: weights, calving and health, even with no signal
This week's barn prices, the Sale Calendar, and a price for any animal you type in
paid: Every animal in your herd priced at your sale barn, every week
Keep or sell, and which heifers to keep, for your own animals
Your herd plan: how many heifers to keep to reach your goal
A Report for Your Lender and a Sale Sheet for your buyer
Your company logo on your reports
Print your answers: a two-page Sell or Keep

free: This season's grass for any Nebraska county
One pasture and herd at a time
paid: My Ranch: all your pastures on one page
Come back any week: saved pastures show the latest forecast
Print your answer: a two-page Grazing Estimate
Plan next season, October to March: how many to keep, and the odds

free: Your county's corn and soybean yields since 2000, with the model's 80% ranges
This season so far, beside a normal year, 2012 and 2022
Maps of every Nebraska and Iowa county, every year
coming: Your own fields: each one's expected yield and range
A Crop Report for your lender, and one for your landlord
Your fields against the county, from your yield maps

free: Will harvest finish in time, from every fall since 2000 in your county
Keep or trade, buy, lease or hire, and resale value
What your tractor pulls, and what holds your harvest back
apps.none: Every tool is free while we test it with farmers.

free: One account for every app, your farm and your fields
Your farm's cards: this week across every app
paid: Your company logo on your reports and your My Farm home page
